executive_assessment.text: Named provincial food-access constraints and July 2026 flood losses add local vulnerability detail, but the seasonal outlook is not a climate-model forecast.
Conflict-linked forest loss and weak capital/support are described adaptation constraints. Reported FAO-supported household gains are historical and do not establish national or causal effects.
